title: The away camp
text: We're taking the group away for three days. Where do we go?

choices.label: Bush camp

effects.why: Three days in swags around a campfire

choices.result: Swags, a campfire and no phones. The group came home closer.

choices.label: Navy camp

effects.why: The group got through a navy camp together
A navy camp set the standard for the summer

choices.result: Four-thirty starts and cold water. They came home tired and tighter.

title: The rookie talent quest
text: The first-years put on the talent quest. Half the act was about the coaches.

choices.label: Laugh it off
choices.result: We laughed along. The kids got their night.

choices.label: Roast them back

effects.why: The coaches roasted the rookies back at the talent quest

choices.result: The coaches hit back. The room was in tears, and the night ran late.

title: Community week
text: The club wants players out in the community this week. How many do we send?

choices.label: A school clinic
choices.result: A few players ran a clinic at a local school. The board liked the photos.

choices.label: The whole list

effects.why: The whole list spent three days in the community

choices.result: Three days of schools, hospitals and junior clubs. The players were spent by the end.

title: Beach and pool day
text: A recovery day off the track. Pool, or the beach?

choices.label: The pool
choices.result: A slow day in the water. The legs came back.

choices.label: A surf lesson

effects.why: The group learned to surf together

choices.result: Plenty of wipe-outs and plenty of laughs. One of the boys came in sore.

title: Cultural day
text: We're spending a day learning about the country we play on.

choices.label: A day on country

effects.why: A day on country with the elders

choices.result: The elders walked the group through the land and its stories.

choices.label: Our players lead it

effects.why: Our Indigenous players led the cultural day
You handed him the cultural day to lead

choices.result: Our Indigenous players ran the day their way. The board wanted a say in it.

title: The leadership workshop
text: The leaders are setting the standards for the year. Do we run the room?

choices.label: Sit in

effects.why: The leaders set the year's standards with the coaches

choices.result: We sat in and steered it. The standards are written up.

choices.label: Hand them the keys

effects.why: The leaders set the year's standards themselves
You let the leaders run the workshop

choices.result: The leaders ran it themselves. The rest of the list felt left out.

title: Families day
text: The partners and kids are coming in. How big do we make it?

choices.label: A barbecue
choices.result: Snags, kids on the ground and a long lunch.

choices.label: A weekend away

effects.why: The families had a weekend away together

choices.result: The whole club went away for the weekend. The board saw the bill.

title: The leaders have voted
text: The leadership group voted for an extra morning session each week. They want to know we'll back it.

choices.label: Back the vote

effects.why: You backed the leadership group's vote for extra work

choices.result: The extra mornings are on. The leaders are pleased, and the rest are tired.

choices.label: Overrule them
choices.result: The vote doesn't stand. The players keep their mornings.

title: The match sim got heated
text: Two of the boys squared up at match sim and had to be separated.

choices.label: Pull the group up

effects.why: You pulled the group up after a fight at match sim

choices.result: We pulled the group up. The standard is set.
